mentions.name: Fine-tuning Whisper to my speech
mentions.description: A fine-tuned Whisper speech-to-text model adapted to the author's voice using an expanding custom dataset, iteratively improving transcription accuracy on words and phrases it still misrecognizes.
mentions.problem: Off-the-shelf Whisper still doesn't understand certain things in the author's speech correctly.
mentions.audience: Fine-tuned for the author's own speech recognition
mentions.source_excerpt:
Trying to improve my fine tuned whisper through more custom dataset. I can still see it not understanding certain things currectly.
